{{Quote|I will not rest until the Tombat is brought before an Imperial court to answer for his crimes!|IOCI Inspector Zanza Gata|<ref name="GNN8" />}}
'''Zanza Gata''' was a [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officer]] with the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] in the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Gata was assigned, at the behest of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Landric]], to bring the art thief known only as the "[[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]]" to justice. IOCI [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Jacen Corbit]] introduced Gata to a packed room of reporters in a dramatic press conference on [[Danteel]].

Gata was described as an extremely capable officer with years of experience bringing crime syndicate leaders, assassins and slicers to trial. His success rate was nearly 84 percent, and he was known to go days without rest when tracking his prey. Gata's uncannily accurate reading of the "Tombat"'s psych profile had become something of a legend around the Office.
